name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when building a custom luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when building a custom luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls include insufficient budget planning, lack of clear communication with your builder, late design changes, and underestimating the time required for permitting and construction. To avoid these, ensure a comprehensive budget contingency, establish clear communication channels, finalize design decisions early, and choose a reputable builder with transparent processes. Proactive planning and a strong partnership with your construction team are vital for a smooth and successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid pitfalls like inadequate budgeting, poor communication, late design changes, and underestimating timelines for a successful custom home build.
